test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No girl is a horse.

Rachel is a girl.

**Conclusions:**

I. Rachel is not a horse.

II. All girls are not Rachel.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Statements:

No girl is a horse.

Rachel is a girl.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d141f49089daa22b566b4cf7b708f0732534bdfe812eb8ef5bde59b024837a40.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Rachel is not a horse. → **Follow **(Rachel is a girl, and no girl is a horse, which means Rachel is not a horse is definitely true)

II. All girls are not Rachel. → **Does** **not follow** (This doesn't necessarily follow. Just because Rachel is a girl doesn't mean all girls are Rachel.)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion (I) follows".**
